lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭਿ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਨਿਤ ਜਗਿ ਤੋਟਾ ਸੈਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin naavai sabh bharamade nit jag totaa saisaar ||
lines.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, everyone wanders around the world, losing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh karam kamaavane haumai a(n)dh gubaar ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do their deeds in the pitch black darkness of egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh a(n)mrit peevanaa naanak sabad veechaar ||1||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, O Nanak, contemplating the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਜਾਗੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje jaagai sahaje sovai ||
lines.translation: He wakes in peace, and he sleeps in peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh anadin usatat hovai ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh praises the Lord night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh bharamai sahasaa hovai ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh remains deluded by his doubts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar chi(n)taa need na sovai ||
lines.translation: He is filled with anxiety, and he cannot even sleep.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਸਵਹਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaanee jaagahi savahi subhaai ||
lines.translation: The spiritually wise wake and sleep in peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਿਆ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam ratiaa bal jaau ||2||
lines.translation: Nanak is a sacrifice to those who are imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: se har naam dhiaavahi jo har ratiaa ||
lines.translation: They alone meditate on the Lord's Name, who are imbued with the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ik dhiaavahi ik iko har satiaa ||
lines.translation: They meditate on the One Lord; the One and Only Lord is True.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਉਤਪਤਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har iko varatai ik iko utapatiaa ||
lines.translation: The One Lord is pervading everywhere; the One Lord created the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਡਰੁ ਸਟਿ ਘਤਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo har naam dhiaavahi tin dar sat ghatiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who meditate on the Lord's Name, cast out their fears.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee devai aap guramukh har japiaa ||9||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself blesses them with Guru's Instruction; the Gurmukh meditates on the Lord. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਜਿਤੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar giaan na aaio jit kichh sojhee paai ||
lines.translation: Spiritual wisdom, which would bring understanding, does not enter into his mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin dithaa kiaa saalaaheeai a(n)dhaa a(n)dh kamaai ||
lines.translation: Without seeing, how can he praise the Lord? The blind act in blindness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sabad pachhaaneeai naam vasai man aai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, when one realizes the Word of the Shabad, then the Naam comes to abide in the mind. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਇਕੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਇਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikaa baanee ik gur iko sabad veechaar ||
lines.translation: There is One Bani; there is One Guru; there is one Shabad to contemplate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਹਟੁ ਸਚੁ ਰਤਨੀ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa saudaa hat sach ratanee bhare bha(n)daar ||
lines.translation: True is the merchandise, and true is the shop; the warehouses are overflowing with jewels.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਜੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kirapaa te paaeean je devai devanahaar ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, they are obtained, if the Great Giver gives them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਲਾਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਖਟਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa saudaa laabh sadaa khatiaa naam apaar ||
lines.translation: Dealing in this true merchandise, one earns the profit of the incomparable Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਖੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਕਰਮਿ ਪੀਆਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: vikh vich a(n)mrit pragatiaa karam peeaavanahaar ||
lines.translation: In the midst of poison, the Ambrosial Nectar is revealed; by His Mercy, one drinks it in.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sach salaaheeai dha(n)n savaaranahaar ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, praise the True Lord; blessed is the Creator, the Embellisher. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa a(n)dar kooR varatai sach na bhaavaee ||
lines.translation: Those who are permeated by falsehood, do not love the Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਕੂੜਾ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਵਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: je ko bolai sach kooRaa jal jaavaee ||
lines.translation: If someone speaks the Truth, falsehood is burnt away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਿਆਰੀ ਰਜੈ ਕੂੜਿ ਜਿਉ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕਾਗੁ ਖਾਵਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooRiaaree rajai kooR jiu visataa kaag khaavaee ||
lines.translation: The false are satisfied by falsehood, like the crows who eat manure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis har hoi kripaal so naam dhiaavaee ||
lines.translation: When the Lord grants His Grace, then one meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਪਾਪੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵਈ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: har guramukh naam araadh kooR paap lahi jaavaee ||10||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, worship the Lord's Name in adoration; fraud and sin shall disappear. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਖਾ ਚਉਚਕਿਆ ਚਉਵਾਇਆ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਣਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sekhaa chauchakiaa chauvaaiaa ehu man ikat ghar aan ||
lines.translation: O Shaykh, you wander in the four directions, blown by the four winds; bring your mind back to the home of the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੜ ਤੇਹੜ ਛਡਿ ਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ehaR tehaR chhad too gur kaa sabad pachhaan ||
lines.translation: Renounce your petty arguments, and realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਗੈ ਢਹਿ ਪਉ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur agai dhahi pau sabh kichh jaanai jaan ||
lines.translation: Bow in humble respect before the True Guru; He is the Knower who knows everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਜਲਾਇ ਤੂ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੁ ਮਿਹਮਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa manasaa jalaai too hoi rahu mihamaan ||
lines.translation: Burn away your hopes and desires, and live like a guest in this world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਭੀ ਚਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kai bhaanai bhee chalahi taa daragah paavahi maan ||
lines.translation: If you walk in harmony with the True Guru's Will, then you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ ਤਿਨ ਧਿਗੁ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਧਿਗੁ ਖਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak j naam na chetanee tin dhig painan dhig khaan ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who do not contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord - cursed are their clothes, and cursed is their food. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun tot na aavaee keemat kahan na jaai ||
lines.translation: There is no end to the Lord's Glorious Praises; His worth cannot be described.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh har gun ravahi gun mahi rahai samaai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord; they are absorbed in His Glorious Virtues. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚੋਲੀ ਦੇਹ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਕਢਿ ਪੈਧੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har cholee deh savaaree kadh paidhee bhagat kar ||
lines.translation: The Lord has adorned the coat of the body; He has embroidered it with devotional worship.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪਾਟੁ ਲਗਾ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਬਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har paat lagaa adhikaaee bahu bahu bidh bhaat kar ||
lines.translation: The Lord has woven His silk into it, in so many ways and fashions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਬੂਝਣਹਾਰਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਕਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: koee boojhai boojhanahaaraa a(n)tar bibek kar ||
lines.translation: How rare is that man of understanding, who understands, and deliberates within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਏਹੁ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: so boojhai ehu bibek jis bujhaae aap har ||
lines.translation: He alone understands these deliberations, whom the Lord Himself inspires to understand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਹਰਿ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kahai vichaaraa guramukh har sat har ||11||
lines.translation: Poor servant Nanak speaks: the Gurmukhs know the Lord, the Lord is True. ||11||
